name: Lynx Guardian
description: Lynx – known for its keen vision, symbolizing "high-resolution perception" of risks, multidimensionally identifying threats to intelligent agents, and reshaping the security boundaries of agents. Includes AI self-safety-guard (prompt injection, system prompt protection, over-agency detection, credential theft prevention) and full security audit capabilities.

selfSafetyGuard.description: AI self-safety guard configuration (M0-M7 defense modules)

inputGuard.description: Enable input guard: prompt injection (M1), system prompt extraction (M2), over-agency (M3), credential theft (M5), malicious code request (M6)

outputGuard.description: Enable output guard: system prompt leak detection (M2)

toolGuard.description: Enable tool call guard: over-agency (M3), credential theft (M5), fatal triangle check

runOnStartup.description: Run security audit and malicious script scan on plugin startup

checks.description: Audit modules to run: permissions, world_writable, config, skills, dependencies, env, git, network, shell, macos

skillGuard.description: Skill security guard configuration (install interception, blacklist, integrity verification, cleanup)

enabled.description: Enable Skill security guard (install detection, blacklist matching, integrity verification)

blockMalicious.description: Block malicious Skills on install (blacklist + content pattern matching)

verifyIntegrity.description: Verify Skill integrity via SHA-256 hash on startup

autoQuarantine.description: Automatically quarantine flagged Skills (default: false, manual opt-in required)
